name: Computer use
description: Desktop/GUI operation. Expect these to be the weakest suite on small local models - that is the signal they exist to give you.

tasks.name: observe the desktop
tasks.goal: Take a screenshot of your desktop and tell me which application windows are currently open.

tasks.name: launch an application
tasks.goal: Open the Chromium browser to example.com, then take a screenshot to confirm it loaded.

tasks.name: shell in the sandbox
tasks.goal: Use the shell to find out which Linux distribution and kernel version your computer is running, and report both.
